items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: after listening to Joe Yamp, which I also like a lot

ctx.x: I don't know why. It didn't sound good to me. Mostly because I got hung up on the piano player. I think I didn't like him at all. No, I like him better. Who is he? It's Charlie Hamilton. Oh, yeah. I didn't dig him at all. I was, after listening to Joe Yamp, which I also like a lot, I just couldn't stand his playing.
Do you think he fits a Kit Thomas Band? No, I don't think so.
